title: BYOK: invocation-scoped multi-provider LLM support (M17)

textFreeze: The 28 AC texts are the sole source of truth; tests/regression/m17-byok-traceability.check.cjs enforces an SHA256 freeze over AC01..AC28 and parity between this register and the canonical array in that test.
